title: Zesty Charred Japanese Chicken Tsukune
description: A light and flavorful Japanese dish featuring charred chicken tsukune, green olives, and tempering chocolate, perfect for a solo dinner.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, mix together the chicken breast, grated ginger, minced garlic, sesame oil, salt, and black pepper.
Use your hands to shape the mixture into small tsukune balls, about 1 1/2 inches in diameter.
Place the tsukune balls on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper, leaving about 1 inch of space between each ball.
Drizzle the coconut oil over the tsukune balls and toss to coat evenly.
Bake the tsukune balls in the preheated oven for 15 minutes, or until lightly browned on the outside and cooked through.
While the tsukune balls are baking, melt the tempering chocolate in a double boiler or in the microwave in 30-second increments, stirring between each interval.
Once the tsukune balls are done, remove them from the oven and brush the melted chocolate over the top of each ball.
Sprinkle the pitted green olives over the top of the chocolate-covered tsukune balls.
Serve the zesty charred Japanese chicken tsukune hot, garnished with additional green olives if desired.
